class.name: NetwPredictDeclaration
class.brief_description: A slot's field wiring, built one [method append_field] call at a time in the order comparison and recovery read them in.
class.description: A declaration is write-only from the outside: [method append_field] grows it and [method clear] empties it, and the only readback is [method field_count] and [method field_at], the key each position holds. Every other property [method append_field] takes is consumed by the slot that compiles this declaration into its wiring, not re-exposed here. [br][br][code]property_class[/code] decides what a field's value does in the simulation and therefore the scope of both comparison and restore: a causal field is compared and restored, a derived one is restored but never compared since the next step overwrites it anyway, and a cosmetic one reaches display only. [codeblock] simulation reads compared restored CAUSAL yes yes yes DERIVED no, recomputed no yes, overwritten next step COSMETIC no, display only no yes [/codeblock] [code]converge_stiffness[/code] pulls a restored value toward the authoritative one instead of writing it outright, and [code]carry_channel[/code] names a sibling field a recovery advances this value along from the acknowledged transition to the present. [code]teleport_only[/code] restricts a field to a teleport-tier recovery alone, [code]reconcile_only[/code] lets a field ride a correction another field triggered without ever triggering one itself, and [code]epsilon_override[/code] and [code]teleport_at[/code] override the entity's default divergence and teleport thresholds for this field alone, or inherit them at a negative value. [code]angle[/code] marks a field whose comparison and blend must wrap around a full turn rather than treat it as a plain scalar.

method.name: append_field
method.description: Appends one field to this declaration at the next wire position. Fields are read back in append order everywhere a field index is used, so the order this is called in is the order [method field_at] and every recovery and comparison accessor address a field by.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every field, leaving [method field_count] at [code]0[/code].

method.name: field_at
method.description: The key [method append_field] was called with at [param index], or an empty name past [method field_count].

method.name: field_count
method.description: How many fields this declaration carries, the bound for [param index] on [method field_at] and on every field index elsewhere this declaration's slot uses.
